blocks.text: Central Park homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Central Park, September 2026. Detached houses: 11 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 18% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 22 listed at month end and 6 sold in September, a sales ratio of 27% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 6 sold over 4 months against an average of 12.0 listed, about 8.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 2 sold. Condos and townhomes: 20 sold over 4 months against an average of 20.5 listed, about 4.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 7 sold.

faq.q: Where is the Central Park sub-area in Burnaby?
faq.a: Around Central Park in south-west Burnaby, between Boundary Road (the Vancouver border) and Metrotown, along Kingsway and Imperial Street; "Central Park" is the GVR MLS® sub-area name and this site files it as Burnaby South (central-park-bs) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What sold in Central Park in September 2026?
faq.a: Condos & townhomes: 6 solds from 22 listings (27% sales ratio); detached: 2 solds from 11 listings (18% — a very small sample). Burnaby-wide, the median detached sale price was $1,825,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $686,000 that month (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which SkyTrain stations serve Central Park?
faq.a: Patterson Station (Expo Line) at the park's north-east corner and Metrotown Station (Expo Line) east of the park.

faq.q: Which schools are in or near the sub-area?
faq.a: Maywood Community Elementary (K–7), 4567 Imperial St, Chaffey-Burke Elementary (K–7), 4404 Sardis St, and the École Inman Elementary French Immersion program, 3963 Brandon St, with Moscrop Secondary, 4433 Moscrop St, and Burnaby South Secondary, 5455 Rumble St, the nearest secondaries; catchments are address-based — check the SD41 locator, and note French Immersion is a choice program, not a catchment.
